lines: A little faith, a little medicine, and a very fast prayer. Yes, I made it back.
I kept one candle burning and one foot moving. Somehow both worked.
I returned with a prayer half-finished and gratitude fully earned.
My hands shook too much for the bell afterward, but I was alive to hear it.
There are nights that make faith very practical. I survived one.
I kept repeating the same blessing until my feet reached home.
The altar looked brighter after that road back.
I made it, though my voice may need a quiet hour.
